title: High Voltage
description: At the end of this creature's turn, it gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
smart_description: At the end of [gold]the creature's[/gold] turn, it gains [blue]per stack[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
notes: Counter-type power that stacks. Each stack independently triggers at the end of the creature's turn, applying Strength to the power's owner.
